info.title: NexG Discovery Engine V1 target API
info.description: Primary Discovery contract. Public read-only release, health, capability, results, collection, merchant, area and consent-gated interaction routes are implemented in the standalone service. Other routes retain their individual proposed status. Platform owners keep catalog and operational authority; Discovery never books, charges, mutates rights or provisions.

profileRevision.description: Server-owned runtime control revision. Changes invalidate paging and delivery tokens.

pageCursor.description: Opaque cursor for revalidating this exact bounded session page.

previousCursor.description: Opaque previous-page cursor in the same pinned session.

taxonomyPaths.description: Where the published release places this merchant in the Discovery taxonomy. Omitted when the source gives no mapped subcategory.

TaxonomyPath.description: Where the published release places a merchant in the Discovery taxonomy. Resolved from the source's own subcategory through the release's source mappings; never inferred from names, text or the request.

GeoPoint.description: WGS 84 coordinates of the merchant's branch, as the source records them.

position.description: Zero-based position in the final delivered page, bound to exposureToken.

PrivateContext.description: Reviewed existing identity/delegation context. No new issuer. Required only for private workflow context/handoff.

OwnerService.description: Reviewed owner service identity/audience and permitted event mapping. Never a public browser credential.

x-profile: Server-authorized low-cost/quality configuration; no caller token/budget privilege
